resources.string: Backups on this phone, daily copy to SD card or USB, backup files, restore

A backup is made every day on this phone (the last 7 are kept), and before every app upgrade or restore. These are lost with the phone: keep a copy off it with Google Drive backup, a daily copy to an SD card or USB drive (⋮ menu), or by saving or sharing a backup file. Tap a backup to restore it; hold to delete it.
No backups on this phone yet.
This is not a LekasPOS backup file.
This backup file is damaged or incomplete (cut short while it was copied, for example). Try another copy of it.
This backup was made by a newer version of LekasPOS. Update the app first (Settings → App updates), then restore it.
This backup belongs to a different store than the data on this phone.

Everything on this phone will be replaced by the backup (a copy of the current data is kept first). Continue as the same till if the old phone is no longer used; choose a new till if both phones will be used.
The backup is ready. The app restarts to finish the restore.
The restore was not done: the data on this phone could not be saved first (%1$s). Nothing was changed. Free some storage and try again.
Delete this backup from the phone?
This till syncs with other tills: after the restore it joins the store as a new till, and sync must be turned on again.
Back up to Google Drive, restore on a new phone, keep every till up to date

Every sale and change is copied to a hidden app folder in the store\'s Google Drive (it does not appear among your files, and no other app can read it). If this phone is lost or broken, install LekasPOS on a new one and turn this on with the same Google account: everything comes back. Other tills of the store use the same copy to stay the same. Selling never waits for it: a till works offline and catches up when it is online again.
Copies to Google Drive by itself every 30 minutes and shortly after sales, whenever online. A new phone or another till of the store gets everything by turning this on with the same Google account.
Google Drive backup needs Google Play services, which this phone does not have. Keep a daily copy on an SD card or USB drive instead (Settings → Backup & restore → ⋮).
Enter a name for this till.
Use the same Google account on every till of the store. The first till creates the store\'s sync folder; the others join it and receive its data.
Sending changes to Google Drive (%1$d of %2$d)…
Getting changes from the other tills (%1$d of %2$d)…
Checking Google Drive for changes from the other tills…

resources.string: Google needs you to sign in again before this till can sync.
The last sync did not finish: %1$s. It is tried again automatically.
No internet connection. This till syncs again as soon as it is online.
A sync file in Google Drive is damaged, so syncing has stopped. Please report this.
The Google Drive of this store is full, so sync and the backup there have stopped. Free space in Google Drive (or buy more storage): it continues by itself.
Google Drive is busy right now. It is tried again automatically.
This till stops syncing. Its data stays on this phone and the other tills keep theirs. Turning sync on again sends this till\'s data again.
Another till in this store has the same till number. Make a backup, then restore it on this phone as a new till, and turn on sync again.

This phone holds an older copy of this till: newer records were already backed up from it (a backup was restored since). So that nothing is lost or mixed up, this phone continues as a new till. Restart the app, then turn the backup on again: everything that was backed up comes back.
You signed in as %1$s, but this till syncs with %2$s. Sign in with %2$s, or turn sync off and on again to move the store to another account.

This till now uses the shop\'s staff and PINs. The PIN set on this till before it joined the shop was removed, with its recovery code: sign in with the PIN used on the shop\'s other tills, or set one in Settings → Staff.

This Google account already holds the backup of a shop with these tills: %1$s.\n\nJoining adds this phone\'s products, sales and customers to that shop on every till, and they cannot be separated again. To keep two shops apart, use a different Google account for each.
Daily sales report to Google Drive

Every day, the sales of the day before are written to the folder “LekasPOS” in your Google Drive: one file a month, such as “2026-10 daily-sales.csv”, with a row for each day (sales, refunds, net sales, tax, total, discount, cost, gross profit). It opens in Google Sheets or Excel.\n\nIt goes straight to Google Drive, so it works with any Google Drive app, even an old one. It needs Google Play services and internet, and it can see only the files it makes. Use it on one till only.
On: the report goes to the Google Drive of %1$s.
Every day, the sales of the day before go to the folder “LekasPOS” in this Google Drive: one file a month, replaced each day with the month so far.
Stop the daily sales report? The files already in Google Drive stay.
The daily report to Google Drive needs Google Play services, which this phone does not have.
Google needs you to sign in again before the report can be uploaded.
The last upload had no internet. It is tried again when the phone is online.
This Google Drive is full, so the report cannot be uploaded. Free space in Google Drive: it continues by itself.
The last upload did not finish: %1$s. It is tried again automatically.
